questions.q_en: In a hut experiment, each of 4 independent snow sensors works with probability 1/2. What is the probability exactly 2 work?
questions.q_zh: 小屋实验中，4 个独立雪况传感器各以 1/2 的概率正常工作，恰有 2 个正常工作的概率是多少？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A model of a summit snow enclosure has fixed perimeter 40 m. What maximum rectangular area in m² can it enclose?
questions.q_zh: 山顶雪地围栏模型周长固定为 40 米，围成长方形的最大面积几平方米？
questions.qtype_zh: 最值优化（定周长最大面积）

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: A linear fit links warmer summit air with faster glacier melting. Why is extrapolating far beyond the observed temperatures risky?
questions.q_zh: 线性拟合把山顶气温升高与冰川融化加快联系起来，为什么远超观测温度范围的外推有风险？
choices: Temperature has no possible effect on ice
The relationship may change outside the measured range
A fitted line proves all future values exactly
choices_zh: 关系可能在测量范围外改变
拟合直线精确证明所有未来值
questions.explain_en: A model validated over one range need not remain valid far outside it.
questions.explain_zh: 在某个范围内验证的模型，远超该范围后不一定仍然有效。
questions.qtype_zh: 科学推理/统计（相关≠因果/抽样/置信区间）

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: A summit snow experiment reports a 95% confidence interval for mean depth. Which interpretation is correct?
questions.q_zh: 山顶积雪实验报告平均雪深的 95% 置信区间，哪种解释正确？
choices: The interval removes all sampling error
The true mean changes randomly after the interval is computed
95% of individual snow depths must lie inside it
Over repeated sampling, about 95% of intervals made this way contain the true mean
choices_zh: 区间消除了全部抽样误差
区间算出后真实均值会随机变化
95% 的单个雪深必在区间内
重复抽样时，用此方法构造的区间约有 95% 包含真实均值
questions.explain_en: The 95% refers to the long-run coverage of the interval procedure.
questions.explain_zh: 95% 指区间构造方法在长期重复抽样中的覆盖率。
questions.qtype_zh: 科学推理/统计（相关≠因果/抽样/置信区间）
